commands.scope: existing publication/source/digest boundaries plus five new readiness groups

readiness_probe_cases: wrong source SHA or approved pin denied before checkout
distinct staging/production environment IDs and rules
owner-only/self review and admin bypass denied
RSA signature, exact issuer/audience/subject/SHA/ref/workflow/run/actor and bounded freshness
trusted GitHub endpoints only; no redirects
no token request before approved source and environment review
no token bytes or raw claims in evidence
limits: Local tests use synthetic in-memory keys and mock GitHub responses; no protected workflow was executed.
Current live owner-only reviewer coverage deliberately fails the readiness probe.
Ordinary GitHub run remains failure; local fixes require separately authorized publication and fresh remote CI.
No AWS/Cloudflare/production authority, Object Lock, metadata publication or live migration was exercised.
Existing publisher source is unchanged; live IAM/custody/candidate/canary execution remains independently blocked.
